Initial release of linkedin-lead-gen skill.

- Enables search, research, and qualification of non-tech founders on LinkedIn for technology services outreach.

- Compiles 10 qualified leads into a structured, professional PDF report with actionable insights and pitch ideas.
- Utilizes browser and web_fetch tools for data gathering and verification.
